mañánas: mañana — in the morning, early (adverbial -s ending on mañana; mañanas fo Minaya 'Minaya set out in the morning'; = por la mañana)
sobejana: sobejano — excessive, enormous, very great (adjective, fem. sg.; sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'; sobejana es la su ganançia 'enormous is his booty'; no modern form, closest enorme, excesiva)
aguardavan: aguardar — they were watching, keeping an eye on, waiting for (imperfect 3rd pl.; a mio Çid aguardavan 'they were watching the Cid'; = aguardaban)
fronteras: frontera — frontier, border region (fem. pl.; moros de las fronteras 'Moors of the border lands'; = fronteras)
unas: uno — some, certain (indefinite fem. pl.; unas yentes extrañas 'some foreign peoples'; = unas)
extrañas: extraño — foreign, from elsewhere (adjective, fem. pl., agreeing with yentes; yentes extrañas 'foreign folk'; = extrañas)
sanó: sanar — he recovered, was healed (preterite 3rd sg.; sanó el rey Fáriz 'King Fáriz recovered'; = sanó)
consejavan: consejar — they took counsel (imperfect 3rd pl., here reflexive se consejavan 'they consulted together'; con él se consejavan 'they took counsel with him'; = se aconsejaban)
calatayut: Calatayut — Calatayud, town in the province of Zaragoza (= Calatayud)
asmado: asmar — reckoned, appraised, agreed (past part., with an 'they have' as perfect: lo an asmado 'they have reckoned/settled it'; = estimado, convenido)
metudo: meter — put, set down (old past part. in -udo; metudo en carta 'put in writing'; = metido)
vendido: vender — sold (past part.; vendido les a 'he has sold to them', with a 'has' as auxiliary placed after the participle; = vendido)
mismos: mismo — own, very (masc. pl., emphatic; sos vassallos mismos 'his own vassals'; = mismos)
fechos: fazer — made (past part., masc. pl., agreeing with the object; fechos los ha ricos 'he has made them rich'; = hechos)
fallariedes: fallar — you would find (conditional 2nd pl., infinitive + -iedes ending; non fallariedes un mesquino 'you would not find one poor man'; = hallaríais)
mesquino: mesquino — poor wretch, needy person (masc. sg.; un mesquino 'a single poor man'; = mezquino, which has since come to mean 'stingy')
sirve: servir — he serves (present 3rd sg.; Qui a buen señor sirve 'he who serves a good lord'; = sirve)
deliçio: deliçio — delight, pleasure, comfort (masc. noun; bive en deliçio 'lives in delight'; = deleite, delicia)
tomáronse: tomar + se — they took themselves, set about (tomaron 3rd pl. preterite + reflexive se, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; tomarse a + infinitive 'to begin to'; tomáronse a quexar 'they began to lament'; = se pusieron a)
quexar: quexar — to lament, complain (infinitive; tomáronse a quexar 'they began to lament'; = quejarse)
vaste: ir + te — you go away (vas 2nd sg. present + reflexive te; ¿vaste, mio Çid? 'are you going away, my Cid?'; = te vas)
nuestras: nuestro — our (possessive fem. pl.; nuestras oraçiones 'our prayers'; = nuestras)
váyante: ir + te — may they go for you, may they go (before) you (present subjunctive 3rd pl. vayan + dative te; nuestras oraçiones váyante delante 'may our prayers go before you'; = que te vayan, que te acompañen)
delante: delante — in front, ahead, before (adverb, fuller form of delant; váyante delante 'may they go before you'; = delante)
fincamos: fincar — we remain, stay (present 1st pl.; pagados fincamos 'we remain satisfied'; = quedamos)
quitó: quitar — he left, quit, gave up (preterite 3rd sg.; quitó a Alcoçer 'he left Alcocer'; = dejó, abandonó)
compeçaron: compeçar — they began (preterite 3rd pl., variant of començar; compeçaron de llorar 'they began to weep'; = comenzaron)
llorar: llorar — to weep (infinitive; compeçaron de llorar 'they began to weep'; = llorar)
cabadelant: cabadelant — straight on, forward, onward (adverb, cab (= cabo 'head, end') + adelant, apocopated; aguijó cabadelant 'he spurred on ahead'; = adelante, derecho adelante)
aves: ave — bird; birds as omens, augury (fem. pl.; buenas aves 'good omens', from the old practice of reading birds' flight; = aves, closest agüeros)
alcocer: Alcocer — Alcocer, spelling of Alcoçer (see alcoçer), the town the Cid sells to the Moors and leaves (pesó a los de Alcocer 'it grieved the people of Alcocer')
fazié: fazer — he was doing, was bringing about (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; pro les fazié grant 'he did them great good'; = hacía)
ivas: ir + se — he was going off (iva imperfect 3rd sg. + reflexive se cut to s, as in commos; ivas cabadelant 'he rode on ahead'; = se iba)
ffincó: fincar — he halted, stopped, remained (preterite 3rd sg., ff- is an f- spelling; ffincó en un poyo 'he halted on a hill'; = se detuvo, se quedó)
poyo: poyo — hill, rising ground, knoll (Latin podium; poyo que es sobre Mont Real 'the hill above Monreal'; = poyo, closest cerro, colina)
real: real — royal (adjective; here in the place name Mont Real 'Royal Mount', modern Monreal; = real)
maravilloso: maravilloso — marvelous, remarkable, extraordinary (masc. sg.; alto es el poyo, maravilloso e grant 'the hill is high, remarkable and great'; = maravilloso)
teme: temer — he fears (present 3rd sg.; non teme guerra 'it fears no war'; = teme)
nulla: nulla — no, any (Latin nulla; fem. sg. after a negative or 'without'; a nulla part 'from no side, anywhere'; si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = ninguna)
daroca: Daroca — Daroca, town in the province of Zaragoza (= Daroca)
molina: Molina — Molina (de Aragón), town in the province of Guadalajara (= Molina)
terçera: terçero — third (ordinal, fem. sg.; la terçera Teruel 'the third, Teruel'; = tercera)
teruel: Teruel — Teruel, city in Aragon (= Teruel)
ido: ir — gone (past part.; ser + ido as perfect of a verb of motion: ido es a Castiella 'he has gone to Castile'; = ido)
enpresentava: enpresentar — he was presenting, offering as a gift (imperfect 3rd sg.; los enpresentava 'he was presenting them'; = presentaba)
vídolos: ver + los — he saw them (vido 3rd sg. preterite + object los, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; = los vio)
sonrrisava: sonrrisar — he was smiling (imperfect 3rd sg.; fermoso sonrrisava 'he smiled warmly'; = sonreía)
quin: quin — who? (interrogative pronoun, variant of qui/quien; ¿quin los dio estos? 'who gave these?'; = quién)
ayrastes: ayrar — you turned your anger on, withdrew your favour from (preterite 2nd pl., -astes ending; Pues quel vos ayrastes 'since you were angered against him'; = airasteis)
llegava: llegar — it was arriving, was reaching (imperfect 3rd sg.; el mensaje llegava 'the message was reaching (him)'; = llegaba)
mandólo: mandar + lo — he ordered it (mandó 3rd sg. preterite + object lo, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; mandólo y çercar 'he had him (the Cid; or 'it', the place) besieged there'; = lo mandó)
tolléronle: toller + le — they took away from him (tollieron 3rd pl. preterite + dative le 'from him', the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; tolléronle el agua 'they cut off his water'; = le quitaron)
lidiava: lidiar — he was fighting (imperfect 3rd sg.; en campo lidiava 'he fought in the open field'; = lidiaba)
venció: vencer — he defeated, conquered (preterite 3rd sg.; venció dos reyes 'he defeated two kings'; = venció)
ondrado: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. as adjective, masc. sg.; rey ondrado 'honored king'; = honrado)
enbía: enbiar — he sends (present 3rd sg.; enbía esta presentaja 'he sends this gift'; = envía)
bésavos: besar + vos — he kisses your (besa 3rd sg. present + dative vos, a possessive 'your'; bésavos los piedes 'he kisses your feet'; = os besa)
piedes: pie — feet (old plural, Latin pedes; los piedes e las manos 'the feet and the hands'; = pies)
amas: amos — both (fem. pl., Latin ambas; las manos amas 'both hands'; = ambas)
acogello: acoger + lo — to receive, take back (infinitive + object lo, the r assimilated to l: acogerlo > acogello; por acogello 'to take him back'; = acogerlo)
prendo: prender — I take, accept (present 1st sg.; prendo esta presentaja 'I accept this gift'; = tomo; modern prender is 'to seize, arrest')
sobresto: sobre + esto — besides this, moreover, on top of this (sobre 'upon' + neuter esto, run together; Sobresto todo 'on top of all this'; = además de esto)
honores: honor — honor, dignity; in feudal use a lordship, fief or office held from the king (pl.; honores e tierras 'honors and lands'; = honores)
avellas: aver + las — have them! (imperative 2nd pl. aved + object las, the d assimilated to l: avedlas > avellas; honores e tierras avellas condonadas 'your honours and lands, have them restored'; = tenedlas)
condonadas: condonar — granted, restored (past part. fem. pl.; Pidal: 'conceder, restituir'; avellas condonadas 'have them restored to you'; = restituidas; modern condonar means 'to remit (a debt)')
venit: venir — come! (imperative 2nd pl., -t for -d like sabet; id e venit 'go and come'; = venid)
digo: dezir — I say (present 1st sg.; yo non vos digo nada 'I say nothing to you'; = digo)
quisieren: querer — they shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; los que lo quisieren far 'those who wish to do so'; = quisieren, now only in legal language, closest quieran)
huyar: huyar — to help, come to the aid of (infinitive after pora; pora mio Çid huyar 'to help my Cid'; a rare word, the lemma is uncertain (perhaps uviar 'to come to the aid of'), and it is not huir 'to flee'; closest ayudar, socorrer)
suéltoles: soltar + les — I release, set free (suelto 1st sg. present + dative les 'their'; suéltoles los cuerpos 'I free their persons'; = les suelto)
quítoles: quitar + les — I release, free from claim (quito 1st sg. present + dative les 'their'; quítoles las heredades 'I free their estates'; = les quito)
besóle: besar + le — he kissed his (besó 3rd sg. preterite + dative le 'his', the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; besóle las manos 'he kissed his hands'; = le besó)
natural: natural — natural, rightful, by birth (adjective; señor natural 'a rightful lord, one owed allegiance by birth'; = natural)
feches: fazer — you do (present 2nd pl., a reduced form of fazedes; esto feches agora 'this you do now'; the sense is clear, the exact derivation less so; = hacéis)
feredes: fazer — you will do (future 2nd pl., syncopated stem fer-; al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later'; = haréis)
nós: nós — we (stressed subject pronoun; con Dios nós guisaremos 'with God we shall arrange it'; = nosotros)
guisaremos: guisar — we shall arrange, prepare, manage (future 1st pl.; = guisaremos, closest dispondremos, arreglaremos)
vós: vós — you (stressed subject pronoun, polite/plural; commo vós lo fagades 'as you shall do it'; = vos, vosotros)
déxenvos: dexar + vos — let them allow you (dexen present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive + dative vos, the -n kept; déxenvos andar 'let them let you travel'; = que os dejen)

__broaden__.aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado) · also ready, prepared (ser + part., impersonal: Ya es aguisado 'now all is arranged')
__broaden__.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned') · also fo — went (ir; mañanas fo Minaya 'in the morning Minaya went'); fo de moros 'it came from the Moors' (ser de + noun of origin; Pidal restores f[o])
__broaden__.el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
__broaden__.fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel') · also fincar — he stayed, remained (el Campeador fincó con su mesnada 'the Cid stayed with his troop'; = quedó)
__broaden__.mala: malo — bad, evil (fem.; la mala cárçel 'the evil prison'; = mala) · also of land, 'poor, wretched' (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly poor')
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar)
__broaden__.mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
__broaden__.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord')
__broaden__.qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also qué — how (exclamative before an adverb: qué bien pago 'how well he paid')
__broaden__.pago: pagar — I am content, satisfied (present 1st sg., reflexive me pago) · also pagar — he paid (preterite 3rd sg., unaccented spelling, = pagó; qué bien pago a sos vassallos 'how well he paid his vassals')
__broaden__.sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
__broaden__.en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men')
__broaden__.aguijó: aguijar — he spurred (preterite) · also aguijar — he spurred on, pressed on (intransitive; aguijó cabadelant 'he spurred ahead'; Aguijó mio Çid 'the Cid pressed on')
__broaden__.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later'
__broaden__.mucho: mucho — much, greatly · also mucho — very, intensifying a predicate (mucho es mañana 'it is much too early, too soon')
__broaden__.mañana: mañana — morning (a la mañana 'in the morning'; otro dia mañana 'next morning'; = mañana) · also mañana — early, soon (adverb/predicate; mucho es mañana 'it is too soon (to take back a man in disgrace after only three weeks)'; = pronto, temprano)
__broaden__.pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing' · also pro — profit, advantage, benefit (grant pro les fazié 'he did them great good, was of great profit to them')
__broaden__.sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer') · also sobre — 'besides, in addition to' (Sobre aquesto todo 'on top of all this')
__broaden__.mont: Mont — mount, hill (Latin montem; = monte); Mont Mayor, the place Martín Muñoz held: Montemayor, a Portuguese town he governed for Alfonso VI, according to Pidal · also Mont Real — Monreal, name of the place above which the Cid's hill stands (Pidal: Monreal del Campo, on the Jiloca); see real
__broaden__.enantes: enantes — before, sooner (adverb; enantes que 'before'; = antes) · also enantes — first, beforehand, in sequence (Metió en paria a Daroca enantes, desí a Molina 'he first put Daroca under tribute, next Molina'; = primero)
__broaden__.desí: desí — from there, thence; thereupon (adverb, des + i 'there'; e desí arriba 'and from there upward'; = desde allí, después) · also desí — next, then in a series (desí a Molina 'next Molina')
__broaden__.tenié: tener — he had, was mounted on (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; que tenié buen cavallo 'who had a good horse'; = tenía) · also tener — he held, kept under his power (en su mano tenié a Çelfa 'he held Çelfa in his hand'; = tenía)
__broaden__.aya: aver — I may have (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = haya) · also aya — he may have (present subjunctive 3rd sg., same form as 1st; de Dios aya su graçia 'may he have God's grace', optative; = haya)
__broaden__.fermoso: fermoso — beautiful (f- for h-; = hermoso) · also fermoso — as adverb 'warmly, graciously' (fermoso sonrrisava 'he smiled warmly')
__broaden__.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda)
__broaden__.mensaje: mensaje — message, messenger's errand (con mensaje 'with a message'; = mensaje) · also mensaje — news, report (el mensaje llegava 'the news was reaching (the king of Valencia)'; = noticia)
__broaden__.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year') · also de cabo — 'again, anew' (que los cometamos de cabo 'that we attack them again'; = de nuevo) · also a cabo de — at the end of, after (a cabo de tres sedmanas 'after three weeks')
__broaden__.quito: quitar — I leave, give up (present 1st sg.) · also quitar — 'I release, pardon, lift the ban on' (a vos quito, Minaya 'I pardon you, Minaya'; = perdono)
__broaden__.do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain) · also dar — I give (present 1st sg.; d'aquí vos do mi graçia 'from here I give you my favor'; = doy)
__broaden__.fagades: fazer — you may make (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = hagáis) · also fazer — after commo 'so that' (commo vós lo fagades 'so that you will do it'; subjunctive, = hagáis)
__broaden__.después: después — afterward, then · also después que — since, seeing that (causal; después que de moros fo 'since it came from Moors')
